selected_observations.excerpt: Term: 24 months. The agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 90 days' written notice before the then-current term ends.

selection_rationale: Auto-renewal judgment depends on the stated Term language in MSA-NBA-2021.
known_missing_information: Distinction between auto-renewal and rolling/month-to-month continuation may require cross-reading with rolling_term obligation.
